name: Carnation Industries Ltd
about: Established in 1983, Carnation Industries Ltd  is engaged in manufacturing and export of grey iron and ductile castings primarily for sanitary and water distribution purposes.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a manufacturer of Ductile & Grey Cast Iron components viz, Gear Box Housing, Clutch Housing, Trumpet Housing, King Post Machine, Carriage Casting, Hydra Clamp Housing, Carrier LHS & RHS, Stub Axle Hub, Intermediate Flange Brackets, Drive Housings, Piston Hydraulics, Cylinder Hydraulics, Bracket Hydraulics etc. It specializes in Automotive, Agriculture, Railway, Earth Moving Equipment, Composer for Refrigeration, Textile and Marine Industries.

cons: Stock is trading at 13.7 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
